resolved_audit_events.description: Documentary attempt 1 checked all 3978 old whole-paper referents against their correct original PAPER base, then erroneously converted the manifest keys to absolute paths before comparing with the provenance's relative-key dictionary. V2 and V3 preserve the relative-key comparison. No file hash or scientific discrepancy.

Documentary attempt 2 rejected a valid three-field launcher pin because the common recorder also emits a fourth symlink:null field. V3 checks every actual recorded key/value as a subset of the full current metadata. The three recorded fields are not omitted or refreshed; all source, hash, byte-size and recorded resolved-path comparisons remain mandatory.
